A turtle starts at the star in the middle. By dragging markers along a grid, she makes 5 line segments. The first segment is red, and then she changes color after each turn, following the progression of a rainbow.

The distance between adjacent dots is 1 unit. The grid is oriented with North pointing up and East pointing right.

Describe the path taken by the turtle.

  • West 4

  • East 5
